name: Creamy Mashed Potatoes (Peeled Russet or Yukon Gold)
whyItWorks: Boiling peeled potatoes and mashing them into a silky smooth consistency eliminates all physical chewing demands and provides soothing, easily absorbed calories. Highly recommended during flare recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel potatoes thoroughly before boiling. Mash with chicken broth or lactose-free milk and a touch of butter or olive oil. Avoid skins, raw garlic, or heavy cream.
watchOuts: Ensure no skin fragments remain in the mash. If lactose intolerant, use lactose-free milk or broth.
